title: Trombonist Roy Palmer
summary: Simeon played jobs with Palmer around Chicago and praises his round tone and ability to transpose and play any part.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Any other favorite musicians you've had on different instruments? Trombone, did you hear Roy Palmer much?
Well I played with Roy on a few jobs around Chicago. He had a nice round tone.
Jelly said he was his favorite trombonist.
He was a very good musician too. He could transpose and play any part, clarinet part, trumpet part, or cello part, almost any part. Well.
